verdict.rationale: Circle documents building blocks for accepting stablecoin payments: wallet-creation APIs that can serve as receiving addresses, webhooks that POST on resource state changes for programmatic confirmation, and idempotency keys. The x402 seller flow returns 402 until a valid USDC payment is attached, but it is aimed at charging AI agents per request rather than at customer checkout. A developer must assemble these pieces rather than use a dedicated customer checkout or payment-intent API. Missing for 10: a documented customer-facing checkout/payment-creation API, a hosted payment page or address-presentation flow for end customers, explicit payment-settlement confirmation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
